notes.text: Real run (cars, 6 sources): end to end OK with SCRAPE_WORKERS=3, first pass 70 rows at 871 s; wall time skewed by 5 NVIDIA 90 s timeouts during the scrape, so a same-source A/B (1 vs 3 workers) follows as a note.

One sample each; directional.

tasks.title: Backend: split scraper.py and RegulatoryFeed.py into smaller modules, no behaviour change

notes.text: Moves only, verbatim blocks: scraper.py 1171->883 (+ plan_scraper.py 300: Selenium listing engine; listing_extract.py 129: HTML tables + LLM listing extract); RegulatoryFeed.py 1460->727 (+ gazette_pdf.py 171, gazette_summary.py 203, gazette_scraper.py 411). Importers (inspector, html_extract) and tests point at the new modules, no re-export shims. symtable check: no undefined or unused globals in any of the 7 modules; each imports cleanly alone (no cycles); 168 tests OK; backend restarted, /health /ready /api/instances + chat dataset/sources/dashboard 200, retired route 404. Left over 300: UniversalScrapeService (~650 lines) and RegulatoryFeedService (~600) are single classes; GazetteScraper is one 375-line class. Splitting them means mixins or delegating wrappers, not a move: left as known debt.

Live re-check rebuilt the test chat's merged table from 70 to 54 rows (06:02 UTC, before Q9 code ran): rebuild_merged_table re-merges all stored records, so more fields per car let merge_records fold near-duplicates. Pre-existing behaviour; looks like dedup, not loss, but unconfirmed.

tasks.title: CI at the repo root: backend tests + frontend gate on every PR

notes.text: Root .github/workflows/ci.yml: backend (py 3.12, pip install -r requirements.txt, compileall, unittest) + frontend (node 24, npm ci, lint, test, audit high, build). Checks only, no secrets, no deploy; actions pinned by SHA (checkout/setup-node copied from Frontend/.github/workflows/deploy.yml, setup-python v6 ece7cb0 looked up via gh api). Dry run of every step in a clean worktree of 7b2f1fe with no .env/.env.local: compile ok, 168 tests OK, lint/test/audit(2 moderate)/build exit 0. Finding: Frontend/.github/workflows/deploy.yml never runs in this monorepo (GitHub reads only root .github); its Cloudflare deploy is the owner's to move.

tasks.title: Backend: import PyMuPDF by its current name so a future release can't silently drop PDF text extraction

notes.text: gazette_pdf imports 'pymupdf as fitz' (PyMuPDF 1.28.2; 'fitz' is deprecated and requirements are unpinned, and the import is optional, so a removal would have silently dropped to pdfminer). New test asserts PYMUPDF_AVAILABLE. Smoke: text extracted from a generated PDF through download_and_extract_pdf; 169 tests OK; backend restarts without the deprecation warning.

tasks.title: Ask about this data: AI plans any question (guardrailed query or sandboxed calculation), answers shown with schema and meaning

notes.text: Ask about this data (owner chose: AI plans, engine runs, no code shown; heavy maths as a hidden sandboxed Python function; dynamic guardrails). Typed questions -> POST /api/ask -> ask_data: model returns a query (checked against this table's columns/kinds by check_query, then again in the browser by toEngineQuery) or a compute function (ask_sandbox: AST allowlist incl. imports of math/statistics only, child python -I -S with empty env, 8 s, Windows Job Object 512 MB + no child processes, RLIMIT on POSIX, 1 MB result cap, 2 at once) or a refusal. Route: 8 MB body cap, 20 asks/5 min per user, guardrail refusals are answers (200), AI down is 503 (60 s budget via llm_json(budget_s)). Answers show meaning + schema-labelled result table. Reviewer pass: no escape found; its DoS findings (Windows memory, result size, nesting crash, body size, rate) fixed with tests. Live with the real AI: query, filtered query, computed and refusal answers all correct, 0 console errors.

NVIDIA: the .env's LLM_MODEL (nemotron-3.5-lightning) timed out for the whole 60 s on every ask this evening; nemotron-3-super-120b now returns HTTP 410 (retired) but is still in llm_client's default chain; nemotron-3-ultra-550b answered in 25-33 s.
